assumptions: Python integers handle arbitrary precision, so 1103515245 * x will not overflow.
The modulo operation % 2147483648 correctly computes mod 2^31 for non-negative integers.
The rng argument is not used because the LCG is fully deterministic.
execution_limitations: The receipt establishes only the recorded program execution under its exact inputs and seeds.
The trusted checker validates output shape, not real-hardware or universal scientific adequacy.
Simulated hardware quantities are model outputs, not measurements of the reference machine.
data.original_hypothesis: The specified LCG produces face counts that fall within two standard deviations of the uniform expectation (10000/6) over 10000 draws, i.e., the generator is 'fair' by the problem's definition.
rival_predictions: At least one face count falls outside the range [10000/6 - 2*sigma, 10000/6 + 2*sigma], refuting fairness.
The first ten (X_n, die_n) pairs do not match the hand-computed specification, indicating an implementation error.
The modulo 6 bias causes faces 1 and 2 to be systematically over-counted beyond the tolerance.
